issues.on_page: Claims, Refunds, Reimbursements, and Other Local Receipts 100,403 (All Funds Combined)
issues.issue: This all-funds line is mostly utility collections (sewer 7,618 + water 31,001 + garbage 9,258, p6), the Electrical Distribution System Lease 33,975, and interest/dividends. Actual reimbursements are only 165 (p4). The line also holds business-type money but is tagged governmental. No category is over half, so the label-based category is defensible, but the line is mixed in both category and fund type.

issues.on_page: Supplementary Budgetary Comparison Schedule for All Funds Combined (p8)
issues.issue: The revenue detail comes from an all-funds combined schedule that mixes governmental and utility receipts (e.g. Sales Tax 23,938 here vs 23,861 on the governmental statement p4). Under the per-fund detail rule (cities/villages), combined all-funds schedule lines are normally replaced. Keeping them is defensible because the General Fund (p9) and Fire Department Fund (p10) have their own schedules, but every line is tagged governmental.
The page does not say what was bought, so 'equipment purchases' is an assumption. The function, general government, is also assumed; the line is marked review.
